title: Massive Voter Fraud Rigged the Election

claims.text: Millions of illegal immigrants voted in the 2024 election.
claims.explanation: No evidence of widespread voter fraud exists. Multiple studies and court cases have found no significant illegal voting.

claims.text: Voter ID laws would prevent 99% of fraud.
claims.explanation: Fraud is extremely rare already. Voter ID laws can actually disenfranchise legitimate voters without reducing fraud.

claims.text: Ballot counting machines were hacked to change votes.
claims.explanation: Audits in multiple states confirmed accurate vote counts. No credible evidence of hacking exists.

claims.text: Over 1,000 verified cases of voter fraud were found in the 2024 election.
claims.explanation: True. While fraud exists in tiny numbers, it's statistically insignificant and didn't affect outcomes.

claims.text: Election officials from both parties certified the results as accurate.
claims.explanation: True. Local, state, and federal officials, including both parties, certified all results.

trust_score_description: Low - Only 2 out of 5 claims are verified
